page.overview:
Who is Ally of Justice Cyclone Creator?

Ally of Justice Cyclone Creator is a character version of the card, "Ally of Justice Cyclone Creator".

It appears in the video game Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2010: Reverse of Arcadia.

This character and Emissary from Pandemonium are unlocked as Tag Duel opponents. Their Tag Team name is Tuner or NOT.
